test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 11 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Odisha has set ______ as the target year for providing 100% functional household tap water connections in every rural household.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2023-24**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Odisha **has set** 2023-24** as the target year for providing 100% functional household tap water connections in every rural household. 
 
• The Odisha government intends to reach 100% saturation of household tap water connections by 2024 in order to provide people with safe drinking water.
 
• **The Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM)** released its annual action plan (AAP), which outlines the State Government's plan of action for the fiscal year 2021-22 as well as the State's saturation plan.
 
• In particular, more than 27% of rural families in the state receive drinking water from the tap, up from 3.63 percent in 2019.
 
• In Odisha, there are 85.66 lakh rural homes, with 23.25 lakh of them having tap connections.
